column1: # p374 — THE COMMITTED LEGS TABLE.  Every regional leg this base has run FIRST-HAND and recorded
# with enough detail to re-judge.  The gate reads this file; prose does not feed the gate.
# fact_class is the column no prior pass carried, and it is what J3 turns on:
#   policy-milestones   who referred what to which body, instrument numbers, dates, legal status
#   operational-detail  counts of schools/teachers/licences -- what is actually deployed
#   survey-figures      measured attitudes or usage rates
# placenames is SEMICOLON-separated and is the literal set of places/organs the QUERY named.
# 🔴 A placenames field holding ONLY a region label is J2 limb 1's refusal case.
# nil_disposition: for a NIL leg only.  PUBLISHED = this base offers it as a measured regional
# nil.  WITHDRAWN-p374 = the nil was published once and J2 refuses it, so it is retracted and
# may not be cited as evidence about the region.  🔴 J2 requires that every nil failing its two
# limbs be marked WITHDRAWN -- a nil cannot be both inadmissible and still on offer.
